findings.claim: A hand edit to a generated Claude agent file will not run the CI drift check because the workflow path filters omit `.claude/agents/**`.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria require drift to fail CI for generated files, including `.claude/agents/` (`Generated files are not hand-edited` and modified lint requirement). The workflow hunk adds paths for `.agents/**`, `.agent-team/**`, `.codex/**`, `.opencode/**`, `.kimi-code/**`, `.minimax/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `scripts/agent-team/**`, but does not add `.claude/agents/**` under either `push.paths` or `pull_request.paths`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `.claude/agents/**` to both `on.push.paths` and `on.pull_request.paths` for the agent-tooling workflow.
